name: FEMA Hazus
description: FEMA's GIS-based natural hazard loss estimation software for earthquake, flood, hurricane, and tsunami hazards. Provides standardized, scientifically based estimates of hazard-related losses to support pre-disaster mitigation planning, emergency preparedness, response, and recovery. Free to download for US users.
domain: natural hazard risk assessment, disaster mitigation planning
reputation: authoritative US federal standard for hazard loss estimation; widely used by emergency managers and planners
notes: Free software requiring ArcGIS Pro license. Covers earthquake, flood, hurricane, and tsunami models. Used for benefit-cost analysis, grant applications, and community resilience planning.
